classification: Terminal-daemon liveness and severed-process recovery text
rationale: Retain seven independent output controls for live/exited/unverifiable and old hosts, process-ceiling states, severed sessions and explicit restart consequences. These formatter tests do not claim process liveness integration.

cases.title: reports a live daemon and its process ceiling
cases.reason: The concrete live PID and enabled 200-process ceiling must appear, without the misleading historical OK result.

cases.title: reports a ceiling that is off and why
cases.reason: A disabled ceiling must expose its concrete no-user-manager reason.

cases.title: never says OK for a daemon that is gone
cases.reason: An exited PID must show exit and next-terminal guidance without stale OK or ceiling text.

cases.title: reports unverifiable when the host cannot prove either way
cases.reason: Unverifiable liveness must preserve the concrete PID and inability-to-answer detail.

cases.title: says liveness is unverifiable against a host that does not report it
cases.reason: An older host omitting daemon liveness must report unverifiable instead of assuming OK.

cases.title: says a restart ends running processes and only resumable agents come back
cases.reason: A severed daemon with three sessions must show its PID, process-ending consequence and distinct resumable-agent versus shell recovery guidance.

cases.title: does not describe an exited severed daemon as still hosting terminals
cases.reason: An exited daemon with stale severed metadata must not claim it still hosts terminals.

classification: Pane-title RPC validation and printed command help
rationale: Keep all four declarations and four explicit title/omitted-title rows. Move direct spec-usage assertions into actual printHelp output, retaining required-title/reset guidance and avoiding parallel raw-inventory assertions.

cases.title: sends an explicit title %j to the pane method
cases.reason: Both REVIEWER and explicit empty title go through actual parsing to the pane-specific RPC with exact terminal/title payload; printed response preserves set/reset semantics.

cases.title: refuses a missing title before resolving a terminal (%j)
cases.reason: Both omitted title and valueless title must reject invalid_argument before resolving a terminal or invoking any RPC.

cases.title: propagates an older host refusal without falling back to tab rename
cases.reason: A typed older-host method_not_found refusal must propagate after one call, preventing a tab-rename fallback.

cases.title: documents a required pane-scoped title and explicit clearing
cases.reason: Require required-title usage and pane-scoped explicit-reset guidance in actual command help; remove direct raw-spec lookup/usage assertions that duplicate the printed path.

classification: Split retry capability negotiation and command preservation
rationale: Keep all three declarations; replace a structural double/cast with an actual RuntimeClient and complete checked status response. The admitted retry now requires exactly one complete split RPC including the original command, rather than only terminal/retry IDs.

cases.title: sends the retry to a host that can resume the split
cases.reason: An admitted retry must send exactly the terminal, original agent command, optional direction and leaf retry identity once. Dropping only the command passes the original partial payload assertion and fails this reviewed case.

cases.title: refuses rather than splitting again on a host without the capability
cases.reason: A reachable older host without the capability must refuse the retry before terminal.split, preventing a duplicate command launch.

cases.title: refuses a blank retry id instead of making a fresh split
cases.reason: An explicitly blank retry ID must reject before any split RPC, rather than becoming a fresh split.

rationale: Keep all three declarations and both local/already-navigated table rows. Replace the structural client cast with a RuntimeClient and typed call/getter spies; require an attempted fallback even when it returns false, so echoed false is not mistaken for attempted navigation.

cases.title: shows the terminal in the local desktop when the windowless server cannot (#24688)
cases.reason: An unsuccessful remote host focus must request host navigation, invoke the local reveal adapter with the remote client/terminal and merge its true result into printed output.

cases.title: keeps navigated false when no local desktop shows that environment
cases.reason: When local reveal returns false, require the adapter to be called exactly once with the intended remote client/terminal and preserve false. A focused mutation run proves the original case passes if reveal is skipped, while this reviewed case fails.

cases.title: leaves %s alone
cases.reason: Both local non-navigation and already-navigated remote host rows must skip fallback and preserve their respective focus verdicts.

parameter_inputs.expression: ['a local terminal the host could not navigate to', false, false]
['a remote host that navigated itself', true, true]
